MultiscaleSCP

Multiscale Systematic Conservation Planning Across Nested H3 Grids

MultiscaleSCP is an R package for systematic conservation planning across nested spatial resolutions, using the H3 hierarchical polygonal grid system and the prioritizr package. It supports the formulation and optimisation of conservation problems with resolution-specific features, costs, and management attributes.

Key features

  • Multiscale planning: Integrate planning units and conservation features across nested H3 resolutions.
  • Overlap-aware optimisation: Meet conservation targets while avoiding double-counting costs and feature representation across overlapping planning units.
  • Cross-scale connectivity: Incorporate connectivity penalties based on parent–child relationships.
  • Solution evaluation: Assess conservation outcomes, costs, and planning-unit selection across resolutions.

Installation

Install the released version from CRAN:

install.packages("MultiscaleSCP")

Or install the latest development version from GitHub:

install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("PJMerlo/MultiscaleSCP")

Getting started

Start with the Multiscale SCP workflow vignette, which demonstrates the package’s main workflow using a small synthetic example.

The tutorial covers building H3 hierarchies, loading conservation features, defining multiscale optimisation problems, solving them, and evaluating the results.
